construction: The cockpit combines two octagonal transparent canopy halves, hinge fingers, a glazed rear panel, side mounts and a pilot subassembly. Read the child pages for its layers and occupant.
interfaces: Retain mating canopy hinges and the panel rim; inspect source mounting bricks and their exact orientation before attaching to a new fuselage.
lesson: Design the cockpit envelope around real canopy halves and hinges before closing the hull.
parent_context: 6887-1.mpd (Allied Avenger) supplies the surrounding spacecraft and mating rear structure. The extraction includes its pilot and several legacy part aliases.
reuse_notes: Use the enclosure and hinge vocabulary in a new cockpit. Preserve the clear opening and actual pilot envelope; any new seat, controls or canopy substitution needs its own fit review.
